name: typescript-lsp
description: Find definitions, references, and inferred types in local TypeScript and JavaScript projects.

interface.longDescription: Follow an import to the file that defines it, or see which files use an exported type before you change it. TypeScript LSP uses your local TypeScript compiler to resolve symbols in saved TypeScript and JavaScript files, including TSX and JSX. Ask for a symbol’s inferred type and documentation even when the source has no explicit type annotation.
defaultPrompt: Follow an import to its definition
Find every use of an exported type in my project
Show the inferred return type of a function

review.commerce_description: Local LSP Tools provides local source navigation without purchases, subscriptions, or payment processing.

publication.release_notes: The setup skill installs a native TypeScript compiler with stdio LSP support and verifies a definition and hover.

es.subtitle: Explora tipos e importaciones
es.description: Sigue importaciones, busca referencias y consulta tipos inferidos y documentación en archivos TypeScript y JavaScript guardados. El plugin utiliza el compilador de TypeScript instalado en tu equipo.
